name: Shelly LoRa Add-on
summary: LoRa radio add-on (up to 5 km, SheLR protocol) for Shelly Gen3/Gen4 relays, meters and dimmers.

requires: Shelly Gen3/Gen4 host (1/1PM/2PM Gen3, DALI Dimmer Gen3, Dimmer 0/1-10V PM Gen3, EM Gen3, Shutter, 1/1PM/2PM Gen4, Dimmer 0/1-10V PM Gen4, EM Gen4, i4 Gen4) on fw ≥1.6

extra.range: up to 5 km line-of-sight, external antenna
extra.gateway_use: host with add-on can relay data from other devices incl. BLU
extra.host_note: i4 Gen3 not in compatible list (i4 Gen4 is)

gotchas: Not standalone — needs a compatible Gen3/Gen4 host and a second LoRa-equipped Shelly at the other end
Not LoRaWAN: uses Shelly's own SheLR protocol, so no TTN/LoRaWAN gateway interop
Pro (DIN) series and Plus/Gen2 devices aren't on the compatibility list
Practical use is script-driven; expect DIY setup
best_for: linking pumps/gates/lights at outbuildings or fields beyond Wi-Fi reach
